responsibility: Defines the full-width AVX-512 VP2INTERSECT intrinsic API for pairwise set-intersection mask generation on packed 32-bit and 64-bit elements. This header exposes the 512-bit _mm512_2intersect_epi32 and _mm512_2intersect_epi64 routines, which produce output masks through pointer arguments by invoking dedicated GCC builtins for the VP2INTERSECT instructions.
